errors.evidence: This information about the dataset and the paper title is not present in the figure itself. It is external information that should not be included in a description of the visual elements of the chart.
The chart's y-axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)". Specifying this as "inference runtime" is an interpretation, as the type of runtime is not explicitly stated in the figure.
The word "significantly" is subjective and evaluative. The description should state the factual comparison (e.g., "has a lower runtime") without adding subjective qualifiers.
